task_summary: Build a 7-day travel itinerary JSON for 2 travelers from Minneapolis covering 3 Ohio cities, with pet-friendly accommodations, specific cuisine preferences, no flights, and $5,100 budget
decomposition_rationale: The task requires two distinct capabilities: (1) searching/querying CSV datasets for cities, accommodations, restaurants, attractions, and transportation data, and (2) assembling the queried data into a constraint-compliant itinerary and outputting valid JSON. These naturally separate into a data querying layer and an itinerary assembly layer.

skills.name: evo-travel-data-search
skills.description: Provides utility functions to discover, load, and query travel planning CSV datasets (cities, accommodations, restaurants, attractions, distance matrix) with filtering support for constraints like pet-friendly, cuisine type, city, state, and budget.
skills.responsibility: All data discovery, CSV loading, schema detection, and filtered querying of travel datasets. Handles case-insensitive matching, pet-friendly filtering via Room rule column, cuisine substring matching, and distance/transportation lookups.
dr_sections: 2. File Discovery Pattern and Schema Auto-Detection
4. Pandas CSV Data Loading and Querying Patterns
5. Reusable Skill Function Patterns for Search Utilities
8. Pitfalls and Edge Cases with Pandas 2.0.3

skills.name: evo-travel-itinerary-builder
skills.description: Assembles a complete 7-day travel itinerary by orchestrating search queries, optimizing multi-city routing, validating budget constraints, and generating the final JSON output file.
skills.responsibility: Route optimization across multiple cities, day-by-day itinerary construction, budget calculation and validation, temporal allocation of travel vs sightseeing days, and JSON output generation to /app/output/itinerary.json.
dr_sections: 7. Route Planning Logic for Multi-City Itineraries
